name: seated toe extensor and foot inverter stretch
description: Seated stretch combining pointing the toes down with a turn of the sole inward.
instructions: Sit and cross one ankle over the opposite knee.
Hold the top of the foot and toes with your hand.
Curl the toes down and turn the sole gently inward.
Feel the stretch along the top and inner edge of the foot.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.
